name: 84120 · W Valley City, UT
findings: ZIP 84120 (W Valley City) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84120 (W Valley City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
65% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 84120 (W Valley City) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 36% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 78% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
